an8.20:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
an8.20:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā tadahuposathe bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto nisinno hoti.
an8.20:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante paṭhame yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ' panāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:1.4: ‘abhikkantā bhante ratti, nikkhanto paṭhamo yāmo, ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho,
an8.20:1.5: uddisatu bhante Bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan' ti.
an8.20:2.2: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante majjhime yāme uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:2.3: ‘abhikkantā bhante ratti, nikkhanto majjhimo yāmo, ciranisinno bhikkhusaṅgho,
an8.20:2.4: uddisatu bhante Bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan' ti.
an8.20:2.5: Dutiyam pi kho Bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi. 3.
an8.20:2.6: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā nikkhante pacchime yāme uddhaste aruṇe nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:2.7: ‘abhikkantā bhante ratti, nikkhanto pacchimo yāmo, uddhastaṃ aruṇaṃ nandimukhī ratti,
an8.20:2.9: uddissatu bhante Bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan' ti.
an8.20:3.1: Atha kho āyasmato Mahāmoggallānassa etad ahosi
an8.20:3.2: ‘kiṃ nu kho Bhagavā puggalaṃ sandhāya evam āha:
an8.20:3.4: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno sabbāvantaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ cetasā ceto paricca manasākāsi.
an8.20:3.5: Addasā kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ dussīlaṃ pāpadhammaṃ asucisaṃkassarasamācāraṃ paṭicchannakammantaṃ assamaṇaṃ samaṇapaṭiññaṃ abrahmacāriṃ brahmacārīpaṭiññaṃ antopūtiṃ avassutaṃ kasambujātaṃ majjhe bhikkhusaṅghassa nisinnaṃ;
an8.20:3.6: disvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena so puggalo ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:3.8: natthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso' ti.
an8.20:4.1: Evaṃ vutte so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
an8.20:4.2: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:4.4: natthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso' ti.
an8.20:4.5: Dutiyam pi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi.
an8.20:4.6: Tatiyam pi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:4.8: natthi te bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ saṃvāso' ti.
an8.20:4.9: Tatiyam pi kho so puggalo tuṇhī ahosi. 5.
an8.20:5.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno taṃ puggalaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā bahidvārakoṭṭhakā nikkhāmetvā sūcighaṭikaṃ datvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an8.20:5.4: uddisatu bhante Bhagavā bhikkhūnaṃ pātimokkhan' ti.
an8.20:5.6: yāva bāhāgahaṇā pi nāma so moghapuriso āgamissatī' ti.
an8.20:6.2: Tumhe 'va dāni bhikkhave uposathaṃ kareyyātha, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyyātha.
an8.20:6.3: Na dānāhaṃ bhikkhave ajja-t-agge pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi.
an8.20:6.4: Aṭṭhānam etaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ Tathāgato aparisuddhāya parisāya pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya. 7.
an8.20:7.1: Aṭṭh' ime bhikkhave mahāsamudde acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.20:7.3: Mahāsamuddo bhikkhave anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro, na āyataken' eva papāto.
an8.20:7.4: Yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto:
an8.20:7.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamudde paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti . . .
an8.20:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā, santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā . . . pe . . . pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā.
an8.20:8.2: Yam pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā; santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā . . . pe . . . pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā:
an8.20:8.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave mahāsamudde aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti.
an8.20:8.4: Ime kho bhikkhave mahāsamudde aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā asurā mahāsamudde abhiramanti. 8.
an8.20:9.1: Evaṃ eva kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.20:9.3: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo anupubbaninno anupubbapoṇo anupubbapabbhāro na āyataken' eva papāto,
an8.20:9.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken' eva aññāpaṭivedho.
an8.20:9.5: Yam pi bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye anupubbasikkhā anupubbakiriyā anupubbapaṭipadā na āyataken' eva aññāpaṭivedho:
an8.20:9.6: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye paṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti . . . pe . . .
an8.20:9.7: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave mahāsamuddo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: timitimiṅgalā timiramiṅgalā asurā nāgā gandhabbā; santi mahāsamudde yojanasatikā pi attabhāvā . . . pe . . . pañcayojanasatikā pi attabhāvā:
an8.20:9.8: evam eva kho bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno . . . pe . . . arahā arahattāya paṭipanno.
an8.20:9.9: Yam pi bhikkhave ayaṃ dhammavinayo mahataṃ bhūtānaṃ āvāso, tatr' ime bhūtā: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno . . . pe . . . arahā arahattāya paṭipanno:
an8.20:9.10: ayaṃ bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭhamo acchariyo abbhuto dhammo, yaṃ disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramanti.
an8.20:9.11: Ime kho bhikkhave imasmiṃ dhammavinaye aṭṭha acchariyā abbhutā dhammā, ye disvā disvā bhikkhū imasmiṃ dhammavinaye abhiramantī ti.
